title: Hosted API Model Lineup: Icebox-to-Flight‑Deck Quarterly Plan
creator: Asha Patel
description: Quarterly plan to move prioritized hosted API model variants from ideation/icebox into a flight-deck-ready lineup. This ticket coordinates feature gating, capacity hedges, eval acceptance criteria, and rollout windows for the Q2 catalog commit. The goal is to produce a defensible set of model variants (by workload tier) with canary schedules, fallbacks, and cost/latency guardrails documented in the console and runbooks.
acceptance_criteria: Final curated lineup for hosted API with primary+fallback model per endpoint tier documented
Canary schedule and rollback criteria authored and approved by SRE and Runtime teams
Perf/eval dashboard for each candidate shows no regression (>95% pass rate on smoke evals)
Capacity hedging plan (burst pool + autoscale thresholds) reviewed with Capacity planning
Release playbook and tags created in Confluence and referenced in console rollout configuration
milestones: Week 1: Candidate shortlist and owner assignments
Week 3: Canary schedule + SLO rollback thresholds finalized
Week 4: Documentation, console config, and release window set
success_metrics: No increase >5% in 95th percentile latency for endpoints after rollout
Average per-token unit cost within forecasted band (±7%)
Canary stability for 72 hours with no elevated error rate
Model health score >= 0.9 on production prompts sample set
